children: Overview
Canada investment firm's Q3 net income rose to C$8.7 mln from a loss last year
Q3 net income per share (Class C) was C$1.28, compared to a loss per share a year ago
Company repurchased 161,200 shares under its normal course issuer bid in the first nine months of 2026
Outlook
Company sees increased M&A activity in small- and mid-cap sector as a positive trend
Company highlights potential for value realization from portfolio companies amid active M&A environment
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year
Result Drivers
INVESTMENT PERFORMANCE - Co attributed Q3 net income to positive investment performance
PORTFOLIO EVENTS - Co cited M&A activity in portfolio companies, including Kneat.com and Sangoma Technologies, as evidence of undervalued technology and active M&A
PRIVATE TO PUBLIC TRANSITION - General Fusion's business combination and Nasdaq listing contributed to portfolio developments in Q3
